_comment: Real public-domain field recordings (radio aporee / archive.org, all Public Domain Mark 1.0). Processed by build-beds.mjs into public/ambience/<id>.wav — a seamless mono loop. Raw sources are cached in .ambience-cache/ (gitignored) and re-fetched from archive.org on demand. Editing this file and running `npm run ambience:build` regenerates the beds. windowStart/loopSec pick a stable stretch of the recording; gainDb is a per-bed trim applied before the shared loudness normalisation so one source does not arrive hotter than the rest.
_license: Every entry is Public Domain Mark 1.0 (no rights reserved). Provenance is written to public/ambience/CREDITS.md by the build.
